answer: Probationary routing quarantine. A new identity’s traffic is routed only through a small crystal of verified peers, and each clone must pay a per-identity deposit that is forfeited on the first mismatch between claimed and observed behavior. Because the lotus of shared infrastructure ties every clone to the same narrow egress pool, a sybil farm’s marginal clone inherits that pool’s congestion cost, and the pigment of its fingerprint cannot be varied cheaply without re-deriving keys.
